description: Marks the client's installation as a canary, so it can receive package updates before other clients of the same agency. Requires the client owner and accepted set to true. It applies no update by itself.

accepted.description: Must be true to confirm the owner opts in.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

name: agency_installation_opt_into_canary
title: Opt Installation into Canary
